mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive (MoM > 0), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates strong consumer demand and labor market health, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST increases > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp MoM, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 tends to decline over the next 20 days due to reduced corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, a leading indicator of broader economic activity and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST growth is positive (MoM > 0), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and a rise in FEDFUNDS signals inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, reducing real equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 0.3% MoM and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing expansion (INDPRO > 112.0), the S&P 500 tends to rise over the next 20 days due to increased corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 112.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
